# 🏥 Healthcare Google Review Auto-Reply Bot
Replies **only** to fully positive Google reviews · EN / HI / Hinglish · safety-checked · daily 9 AM
**Rule:** no negative word + no negative tone + ≥1 positive word = Reply. Anything else = Exit.

## ⏰ START
Daily 9 AM or manual test

## 📥 READ
Skip handled reviews, fetch new ones

## 💬 REPLY
Safety check → post English reply

## 📊 LOG
Every review saved to Excel
